name: JMSFusion
description: Frontend enhancement plugin for Jellyfin Web and web-wrapper mobile clients; native Android TV clients are not supported.
overview: Custom script loader for the Jellyfin web UI.

versions.changelog:
v3.8.2.26 (ParticularFlix fork)

Faster home and slider loading, access control fixes and a notice for profiles that block everything. Same plugin GUID, no setting changes. Includes the unpublished internal build 3.8.2.25.

Fixes:
- "Because you watched" no longer disappears after access profile changes: the per-user section cache of Home Screen Sections is cleared on every apply, lock, unlock and revert (by reflection; no effect if that plugin is not installed).
- List caches carry a per-user generation raised on every permission change, so stale pages can no longer write old content back after a lock, unlock or revert.
- A profile that blocks everything no longer leaves an empty "Personalized recommendations" row on screen; the row is hidden and a notice asks to contact the administrator (Portuguese, English, Spanish).
- Policy changes outside the six access fields are logged as a warning.

Performance:
- Row scroll buttons measured in one frame; slider layout repair no longer runs on normal loads.
- Quality badge priming and non-critical start-up tasks run in small idle slices.
- Subtitle customizer font grouping cached (about 550 ms saved at start-up); scroll pin, home section order and slider header offset no longer poll or react to every slider change; redundant forced layouts removed.

Upgrade notes: the plugin folder is now named JMSFusion_3.8.2.26; update the Docker volume mount path if you mount it. Full notes: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v3.8.2.24 (ParticularFlix fork)

Access control release on top of 3.8.2.17 (rolls up the unpublished 3.8.2.18 to 3.8.2.23 builds). Same plugin GUID, no setting changes (new options have safe defaults).

Changes:
- New Access Control tab (administrators only): edits the native Jellyfin permissions of each non-administrator user (maximum parental rating, unrated content, blocked and allowed tags, libraries), so the server enforces them on every app and device. Templates included, and the original permissions of each user are stored and can be restored with one click. Administrators can never be restricted.
- Optional temporary unlock with the global parental PIN (1 to 480 minutes): full access, a higher rating, or back to the original permissions. The restriction is restored automatically by the server, and list caches are cleared on every change.
- Studio Collections settings: the "Other libraries" rows now have one checkbox per row (Recently Added, Continue Watching, Recent Episodes), so a Collections library no longer shows an empty Continue Watching row.
- Pause screen debug log is off by default; missing Portuguese, English and Spanish translations filled in.

Upgrade notes: the plugin folder is now named JMSFusion_3.8.2.24; update the Docker volume mount path if you mount it. Full notes: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v3.8.2.17 (ParticularFlix fork)

Same plugin GUID, no setting changes required (new options have safe defaults).

Changes:
- New option: slider list cache (minutes). The recent releases and recent premieres slider sources now refresh their candidate list every 3 minutes by default (was a fixed 30), so a title added just now shows up in the main slider much sooner. Query API page, 1 to 120 minutes.
- Trailer preview card redesigned in a bigger, Netflix-style layout: 500 px wide, true 16:9 video, action row under the video, volume slider opening sideways, softer shadow and animation, no picture-in-picture or cast icons over the preview.
- New option: preview card size (Small 400 px, Medium 500 px, Large 600 px, Extra large 700 px). The whole card scales together and is limited to fit the window.

Upgrade notes: the plugin folder is now named JMSFusion_3.8.2.17; update the Docker volume mount path if you mount it. Full notes: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v3.8.2.14 (ParticularFlix fork)

Home page release on top of 3.8.1.1 (rolls up the unpublished 3.8.2.x builds). Same plugin GUID, no setting changes.

Changes:
- TRAILER button rebuilt: plays the local trailer in a native video player (YouTube only as fallback), also for local-only trailers, always visible and placed right after the Watch button.
- Slider no longer blurred, cut or mounted above the visible area after Back, and no longer rebuilt when switching home tabs.
- Home rows load ahead of scrolling, render complete from cache, and come back instantly after Back (inert snapshot).
- Built-in home section order module (Home Screen Sections aware); custom CSS or scripts to force the order are no longer needed.
- Studio hubs group every studio of the same brand, no longer hang on open, and the preview is completed with the best remaining items.

Upgrade notes: the plugin folder is now named JMSFusion_3.8.2.14; update the Docker volume mount path if you mount it. Full notes: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v3.8.1.1 (ParticularFlix fork)

Big release on top of 3.7.3.0 (rolls up the unpublished 3.7.4.0, 3.8.0.0 and 3.8.1.0 builds). Same plugin GUID, no setting changes.

Changes:
- Automatic trailers: a scheduled task (every 6 hours) plus a watcher for new movies and series downloads the trailer for every title that has none, Brazilian Portuguese first, then Portuguese on YouTube, then English; yt-dlp is updated before each run and the YouTube cookies file is optional
- Custom scripts and styles folder (JMSFusion/custom) injected together with the plugin, replacing boot-time sed patching of index.html
- Faster home: top rank, home rows and studio hubs load in parallel, fewer requests per slide
- Fixes: upcoming releases badge, backdrop error loop, Turkish leftovers translated, trailers settings tab cleaned up and translated in 9 languages

Upgrade notes:
- The plugin folder is now named JMSFusion_3.8.1.1; if you mount the plugin folder as a Docker volume, update the mount path
- If you used an external trailer script or Windows scheduled task, disable it once the new task works
- Restart Jellyfin and hard refresh the browser (Ctrl+F5)

Full list: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v3.7.3.0 (ParticularFlix fork)

Speed release on top of 3.7.2.0. Same plugin GUID, no setting changes.

Changes:
- The plugin's JavaScript is cached by the browser for good (versioned URLs served as immutable); a normal refresh no longer revalidates ~100 files, which matters a lot over a VPN
- Import map plus modulepreload hints: modules are fetched in parallel instead of level by level
- No more blocking plugin check at page start (skipped when the plugin answered in the last 10 minutes)
- Trailers start sooner: lookup and stream URL are resolved ahead of time for the active slide and its neighbours, and the automatic start waits 120 ms instead of 500 ms
- Performance marks (jms:boot ... jms:splash-hide) for diagnosing slow loads

Upgrade notes:
- The plugin folder is now named JMSFusion_3.7.3.0; if you mount the plugin folder as a Docker volume, update the mount path
- Restart Jellyfin and hard refresh the browser (Ctrl+F5)

Full list: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

- Unmuting restores the last volume you set instead of jumping to 100%

Upgrade notes:

v3.7.1 (ParticularFlix fork, based on upstream 3.7.0.0)

Upgrade notes:
- Your settings are kept; every new option defaults to the old behavior
- Docker Desktop on Windows: keep the plugin in a local Docker volume, not a bind mount (the 60+ MB DLL gets corrupted assets from bind mounts)
- Restart Jellyfin and hard refresh the browser (Ctrl+F5)

New:
- Slider list sources (current releases / recent premieres) with a time window
- 'New season' badge on series slides
- Per-profile settings (desktop and mobile independent)
- Hover trailer controls, notification open mode, Studio Hubs improvements

Security:
- Non-admin users no longer receive configuration keys; configuration writes are admin-only

Performance:
- Gzip/Brotli for the /slider modules, layer trim on slides and cards, lighter home rendering

Full list: https://github.com/hebolysouza/ParticularFlix-JMSFusion/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
